blocks.name: Function_1

blocks.value: Sends a request to the Compliance API to evaluate newly introduced checks as part of a new compliance catalog, supporting continuous compliance validation.

meta.description: This workflow initiates an OpenSCAP scan on the target RHEL machine and subsequently invokes the Compliance API. The API triggers the Assessment Agent, which performs additional control checks. The results from both the OpenSCAP scan and the Assessment Agent are then aggregated into a unified OSCAL Assessment Result, which is ingested into Concert.
